findings: Change `formation.type` from `indicative` to `disputed`. The entry presents competing formation accounts: a modern paleographic interpretation of the strokes as counting rods, which does not establish that the earliest graph copied rods, and a later lexicographic Heaven–Earth–humanity interpretation. The evidence supports neither an unqualified indicator-mark analysis nor a pictograph classification as established (X-cf2e4185c438e7569f0f, X-718d8d468383943ee429, X-8c0f487b4c1e18b89eff).
